counterfactual_missing_items: High precordial ECG did not demonstrate Brugada pattern
Genetic testing identified no pathogenic variants
decisive_items: Telemetry showed frequent ventricular ectopy triggering ventricular fibrillation
no edema or late gadolinium enhancement
response.rationale: R5 is best supported by direct telemetry of ventricular ectopy triggering VF, an otherwise negative structural and genetic workup, and targeted ablation of culprit PVCs. R1 shares the PVC-triggered polymorphic VT phenotype, but negative genetic testing and a focal ablation strategy favor idiopathic VF over CPVT. R4 is undermined by only borderline-to-normal QTc values. R2 and R3 are directly excluded by absence of Brugada and early repolarization patterns.

rejected.why: High precordial ECG explicitly did not demonstrate Brugada pattern.
Follow-up ECG explicitly documented absence of early repolarization pattern.
QTc values were borderline/normal (443 ms then 433 ms) and genetic testing found no pathogenic variants; no definite long QT phenotype.
